annotations.target_phrase: Rue Jules Verne was a circumferential avenue, looping the spindle’s midpoint
annotations.annotation_text: The non-Euclidean cylindrical geography of Freeside: a closed, looping orbital topography where traveling straight eventually returns the walker to their starting point, mirroring the recursive logic of AI and the matrix.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 164.

annotations.target_phrase: drone microlight bank gracefully in an updraft
annotations.annotation_text: Autonomous winged security drones disguised as butterflies patrolling the artificial thermal currents of Freeside, blurring the boundary between mechanical surveillance and ornamental wildlife.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 164.
